ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics maps tumor niches linked to immune exclusion and invasion
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved single-cell profiling now connects tumor niches to immune exclusion, invasion and prognosis across multiple cancer types.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomes and machine learning nominate immune-linked candidate genes in disease
ranked.summary: Standard ML pipelines on public transcriptomes now increasingly add genetic and single-cell evidence layers to biomarker nominations.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics links transcriptional states to clinical and tumour features
ranked.summary: Multimodal single-cell and bulk profiling now ties transcriptional and epigenetic states to prognosis and clonal architecture.

ranked.headline: ML-integrated single-cell analyses link myeloid and fibroblast states to fibrosis
ranked.summary: Single-cell transcriptomics and machine learning are increasingly used to nominate candidate drivers of fibrotic and inflammatory disease.

ranked.headline: Integrated multi-omics pipelines yield prognostic gene signatures across solid tumors
ranked.summary: Public transcriptomic cohorts, single-cell and spatial profiling are now combined to nominate prognostic and immune-linked biomarkers.
